## Definitions

- [statement] RTPP is not exposed for monitoring through the Atlas Administration API, although project settings can enable or disable it through that API. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel

## How it works

- [statement] Query-targeting ratios are diagnostic clues; MongoDB Search change-stream cursors can raise these ratios and trigger alerts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Use RTPP during a reproducible slow request to locate resource spikes and active operations, then investigate query details separately. A published aggregation experiment demonstrates this workflow. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel · also: https://nljug.org/foojay/why-mirroring-production-in-dev-helps-you-avoid-costly-mistakes/
- [statement] RTPP may fail when db.currentOp() output exceeds its 4 MB per-sample maximum. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] Atlas documents one-second RTPP granularity. The Administration API can enable or disable RTPP, but cannot monitor its live panel data. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] RTPP targets ongoing operations; Atlas separately describes Query Profiler as providing historical slow-operation samples for up to seven days. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/analyze-slow-queries.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] COMPASS-10802 records an RTPP link returning 404 because /host/ was used instead of /metrics/. The issue was resolved with fix version 1.49.11. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-01) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/COMPASS-10802 · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel

## Facts and statements

- [statement] RTPP is Atlas's live triage panel for current database operations, network traffic, and host resources; it helps correlate query latency with resource pressure. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md
- [statement] RTPP requires M10+ clusters. OneUptime and a Severalnines-authored answer independently corroborate this eligibility restriction. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-use-mongodb-atlas-monitoring-for-cloud-deployments/view, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/74064516/finding-mongodb-cpu-usage-disk-utilization-ram-using-query-command
- [statement] RTPP's Slowest Operations uses db.currentOp(); Hottest Collections uses mongotop, and execution-latency charts use serverStatus opLatencies. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] Pausing RTPP freezes its display while underlying data collection continues; resuming restarts its line graphs with an empty display. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] The Kill Op control invokes db.killOp() on the selected running operation and requires an authorized project role. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md
- [statement] MongoDB documents one-second granularity for RTPP. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/monitoring-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] RTPP uses mongostat for operation counters, mongotop for hot collections and db.currentOp() for the slowest current operations. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] MongoDB Search change-stream cursors can inflate query-targeting ratios, so a high ratio alone does not establish an application indexing defect. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] Queryable Encryption hides affected collections from Hottest Collections and redacts query JSON involving encrypted fields. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/real-time-performance-panel.md · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
- [statement] Vokint recommends pairing Atlas live operations and cluster signals with application OpenTelemetry traces; this is an integration recommendation, not proof that RTPP provides distributed tracing. (low confidence) — https://invokfung.github.io/blog/2025/08/19/mongo_26_opentelemetry_observability/ · keywords: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel
